summary: Kennedy-Wilson Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a private offering of $1.8 billion in senior notes (2031 and 2033) to finance a planned going-private merger. The merger, originally announced February 16, 2026 and amended March 25, 2026, involves an entity led by CEO William McMorrow and Fairfax Financial Holdings. Proceeds will redeem existing 4.750% notes due 2029/2030 and purchase 5.000% notes due 2031. If the merger closes after the offering, proceeds are escrowed; if not closed by November 16, 2026, notes face special mandatory redemption at 100%. Watch for regulatory approval and shareholder vote deadlines.
